base_member_text: INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE ignores its Beta argument: alpha is hardcoded to -0.39 (L534) with the developer comment (L532-533) acknowledging the inconsistency between the formula, -0.39 and -0.10
audit_member_text: Interface/implementation mismatch: INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE declares Beta as an input at L525, but the intended Beta relation is commented out at L531 and alpha is always overwritten with -0.39 at L534 before SUB_SLTRY L536. Caller-supplied Beta has no effect.

base_member_text: INITIAL_WAVE is entirely dead code: unconditional goto 200 (L123), goto 100 (L135) and goto 213 (L150) skip the box, dam-break and alongshore-crest branches, and the Gaussian is commented out (L143-145) - the routine computes xx/yy (L104-114) and constants (L116-119) but never modifies Eta
audit_member_text: Control-flow neutralizes INITIAL_WAVE: GOTO 200 at L123 skips the box assignment L125-L131; GOTO 100 at L135 skips the dam-break assignment L137-L141; GOTO 213 at L150 skips the alongshore crest L151-L157. Thus the callable subroutine returns without assigning Eta in any of its three sample blocks.

base_member_text: Serial INITIAL_RECTANGULAR (L228-243) applies Eta(Il:Ir,Jl:Jr)=AMP without the bounds clipping the PARALLEL branch has (L220-227) - out-of-range Xc/Yc/WID would index outside Eta
audit_member_text: Serial INITIAL_RECTANGULAR computes Il/Ir/Jl/Jr at L231-L239 and directly assigns Eta(Il:Ir,Jl:Jr) at L242 without the overlap test and clipping used by the parallel branch at L220-L226. Centers or widths outside the local array can form out-of-range sections only in the serial path.

base_member_text: Cross-line: SUB_SLTRY argument order at call site (L536) maps Cph to r1 (celerity) and B to bue, A1/A2 to ae1/ae2, A to au - caller's Cph and C_ph both receive celerity (Cph unused afterward); zr computed @L632 but never returned or used

INITIAL_GAUSIAN header comment @L251 says keyword 'INI_REC' (copy-paste from INITIAL_RECTANGULAR); gamma_s argument of INITIAL_N_WAVE (L439, L447) and x2 (general N-wave form, commented @L490) are unused; tlag @L71 computed but unused
Loop indices I,J in INITIAL_RECTANGULAR/GAUSIAN/DIPOLE come from USE PARAM (not declared locally, IMPLICIT NONE in effect) - shared module-level indices as in other files
N-wave dep==0 guard STOPs with the explanatory WRITE commented out (L456), as does SUB_SLTRY non-convergence (L611) - both die silently
SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY imposes only Eta/H at the single column Ibeg each step; velocity is deliberately not imposed (comment L75)

audit_member_text: WID is used as a divisor in every Gaussian/dipole branch (L292, L305, L318, L327, L381-L382, L395-L396, L409-L410, L419-L420) without a nonzero/positive check; WID=0 makes the profile singular.

INITIAL_N_WAVE checks only dep==ZERO at L455-L458, but the formulas at L463 and L493 require positive dep and a compatible Ha/dep for nested square roots. Negative depth or amplitude/depth combinations can enter invalid square roots. Arguments x2 and gamma_s in the interface L439 are never used in L439-L499.

SUB_SLTRY divides by h1 and alp at L595 and L598-L600 without validation, and Newton's update L607 has no fpx==0 guard. The only iteration protection is STOP after ite>10 at L610-L613; invalid coefficients can divide by zero before that check.
